title: MetLife Certificate of Insurance — North Carolina Office of State Human Resources, Group Policy 165756-1-G, Low Option (OSHR title: 'MetLife Dental Low Option Certificate (1/1/20)')

document_date_note: Face page: 'Certificate Date: January 1, 2020'. Predates the 2026 plan year; the 2024 riders apply only to the High and Classic certificates. No newer Low certificate posted as of 2026-10-03.
